integrity: The conclusion follows from a written analytic proof and reproducible finite checks; historical priority is provisional. No independent assessment has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats three arclength-uniform points on a common hyperbolic circle, not volume-uniform points; the Pareto and marked limits concern the fixed-angular-sample large-radius limit variable. No uniform exchange of radius and tail limits or moment convergence is claimed.
title: A universal half-Pareto incircle deficit in large random hyperbolic triangles
